03812 Le'ah {lay-aw'}

源自 03811; 陰性專有名詞

欽定本 - Leah 34; 34

利亞 = "疲倦的"
1) 拉班的女兒, 雅各的大老婆, 流便、西緬、利未、猶大、以薩迦、西布倫和底拿的母親
record.edic_text:
03812 Le'ah {lay-aw'}

from 03811;; n pr f

AV - Leah 34; 34

Leah = "weary"
1) daughter of Laban, first wife of Jacob, and mother of Reuben,
   Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, and Dinah
